# Task P1-12: Frontend — Wanted, Activity (History, Blocklist), Settings (Quality profiles, Library)

**Phase:** 1 · **Depends on:** P1-08, P1-10 · **Suggested tier:** cheap worker · **Estimated size:** M

## Goal
The placeholder Wanted, Activity and Settings pages become real: Wanted lists Missing and Cutoff Unmet songs, Activity shows History and the Blocklist (the Queue arrives in Phase 2), and Settings edits quality profiles and the library (layout, naming template, album policy). Everything reads and writes the Phase 1 API through typed TanStack Query hooks.

## Deliverables
1. `frontend/src/api/schema.d.ts` regenerated from the committed `docs/api/openapi.json` with `npm run gen:api` (never hand-edited).
2. `frontend/src/api/wanted.ts` — hooks `useWantedMissing(paging)`, `useWantedCutoff(paging)`, `useHistory(paging, filters)`, `useBlocklist(paging)`, `useDeleteBlocklistItem()` (invalidates the blocklist query). `frontend/src/api/profiles.ts` — `useQualityDefinitions()`, `useQualityProfiles()`, `useSaveQualityProfile()` (POST when `id` is 0, else PUT), `useDeleteQualityProfile()`, `useLibraries()`, `useSaveLibrary()`. Types from `components['schemas'][…]`; errors via the existing `ApiError`; a helper that turns an RFC 7807 validation body (`errors: { field: [messages] }`) into a `Record<string, string>` for form fields. Paging param type `{ page, pageSize, sortKey, sortDirection }` shared in `frontend/src/api/paging.ts`. Do not put these hooks in `hooks.ts` (another task adds `frontend/src/api/songs.ts` in parallel).
3. `frontend/src/components/SongCells.tsx` — small shared pieces: `CoverThumb` (40 px `Image` of `albumContext.coverUrl` with a lucide `Disc3` placeholder on null or load error), `formatDuration(ms)` → `m:ss` (`h:mm:ss` from one hour), `formatDate(iso)`; and `frontend/src/components/PagedTable.tsx` — a generic Mantine table with clickable sortable headers (`aria-sort`), a `Pagination` below, and the loading/empty/error states from `DataState`.
4. `frontend/src/pages/WantedPage.tsx` — Mantine `Tabs` "Missing" / "Cutoff Unmet" (tab in the URL: `/wanted/missing`, `/wanted/cutoff`; `/wanted` redirects to missing). Columns: cover, Title, Artist, Album, Duration, Quality profile (name looked up from `useQualityProfiles`), Added; sortable Title/Artist/Added; 50 per page; empty text "Nothing is missing." / "Every file meets its cutoff.".
5. `frontend/src/pages/ActivityPage.tsx` — `Tabs` "Queue" (empty state "The queue arrives with the Soulseek source in Phase 2."), "History" (Date, Song — Artist, Event as a coloured `Badge`, Quality name from `useQualityDefinitions`), "Blocklist" (Date, Song, Source, Key, Reason, a remove `ActionIcon` that opens a Mantine `Modal` to confirm — **never** `window.confirm`). URLs `/activity/queue|history|blocklist`.
6. `frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx` + `frontend/src/pages/settings/QualityProfilesPage.tsx`, `QualityProfileEditor.tsx`, `LibrarySettingsPage.tsx` — Settings has sub-routes `/settings/profiles` (default) and `/settings/library` with a `Tabs`/`SegmentedControl` switcher.
   - Profiles: one `Card` per profile (name, cutoff name, allowed group names, "Upgrades on/off"); "Edit" opens the editor in a `Modal`; "Add profile" opens it pre-filled as a copy of the first profile named "New profile" with `id` 0; "Delete" asks in a `Modal`, and a 409 answer is shown as an error (`Alert`) in that modal.
   - Editor: name, "Upgrades allowed" `Switch`, the items **best first** (reverse of the API order), each row a `Checkbox` "allowed" + the group name (or the single quality's name) + its qualities as `Badge`s; "Cutoff" `Select` offering only qualities in allowed items; minimum score `NumberInput` (0–1000); duration tolerance in **seconds** (`NumberInput`, 0–60, sent as ms). Save sends the full resource; server validation messages appear under the matching fields (unknown fields in a general `Alert`). No drag-and-drop reordering (out of scope).
   - Library: the default library's form — name, root path, layout `Select` (Flat / Artist / Artist → Album / Plexamp), naming template `TextInput` with a hint listing `{Artist Name}`, `{Album Title}`, `{Track Title}`, `{track:00}`, album policy `Select` whose options each carry a one-line description (fewest albums: "the fewest real albums per artist, the rest in a Singles album" …, from LIBRARY_OUTPUT §7.3), min tracks per real album `NumberInput` (1–10, only shown for fewest albums); Save → PUT; validation errors per field; a success `notifications.show`.
7. `frontend/src/app/App.tsx` routes updated (`wanted/:tab?`, `activity/:tab?`, `settings/*` as above); nothing else in the shell changes.
8. Tests (Vitest + Testing Library, `installFetch` route tables; add fixtures to `frontend/src/test/fixtures.ts`): `WantedPage.test.tsx` (rows render with duration `6:09` for 369000 ms and the profile name; switching to Cutoff Unmet requests `/api/v1/wanted/cutoff`; clicking the Title header requests `sortKey=title`; empty and error states), `ActivityPage.test.tsx` (history badges; blocklist remove → confirm modal → `DELETE /api/v1/blocklist/7`), `QualityProfilesPage.test.tsx` (editor shows best first; unticking the cutoff's group removes it from the Cutoff options; save sends `PUT /api/v1/qualityprofile/1` with `durationToleranceMs` 3000 for 3 s; a 400 `errors.cutoff` message is shown under Cutoff; delete 409 shows the alert), `LibrarySettingsPage.test.tsx` (policy change + save sends `albumPolicy: "singlesOnly"`; min tracks hidden for other policies).

- `frontend/src/app/App.tsx`, `frontend/src/test/fixtures.ts`

## Context to read first
- `docs/build/CODING_STANDARDS.md` (Frontend); `docs/architecture/LIBRARY_OUTPUT.md` §7.1 and §7.3; `docs/architecture/QUALITY_DEFINITIONS.md`
- `frontend/src/api/{client,hooks,errors,types,context}.ts`, `frontend/src/components/{AppLayout,DataState}.tsx`, `frontend/src/pages/system/TasksPage.tsx` + `.test.tsx`, `frontend/src/test/{helpers.tsx,fixtures.ts}`
- The API shapes in `docs/api/openapi.json` (`/api/v1/wanted/*`, `/history`, `/blocklist`, `/qualitydefinition`, `/qualityprofile`, `/library`)

## Constraints
- Packages are fixed (see `frontend/package.json`: React 19.3, Mantine 9.6.3, TanStack Query 5.104, react-router 8.4, lucide-react 1.48, openapi-fetch 0.17, TypeScript 5.9.3, Vitest 5, ESLint 10 + typescript-eslint 8.70): **no new dependencies**, and nothing that needs `@mantine/form` or `@mantine/modals` (not installed — use `Modal` from `@mantine/core` and component state).
- No `any` without a comment; no raw `fetch` — only the typed client; every page has loading, empty and error states; Prettier formatting (`npm run format` must pass).
- Run `npm ci` once in `frontend/` if `node_modules` is missing.

## Acceptance criteria (each must be demonstrated)
1. In `frontend/`: `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run format` and `npm run build` all pass (paste the final lines).
2. The tests listed in Deliverables 8 exist and pass; the existing tests still pass.
3. `git diff --stat` shows no files outside the allowed paths (in particular no backend files, no `package.json`/lock changes).

## Out of scope
- The Library song list, Add songs, paste and unresolved review (P1-11), the Queue (Phase 2), profile reordering, creating libraries.
